chapter.verse: Topa aw, nangma gam, na lungsim tawh kituak hi; Jakob’ nopsaknate a ngeina na bangsak kik hi.
Na mite’ mawhna na maisak a, amau khialhna khempeuh na maisak hi.
Na hehna khempeuh na damsak a, na sin so-na na daisak hi.
Kote’ kihotkhiatna Pasian aw, kote ka ngei uh hong bangsak kik in la, kote tunga na lungkim lohna beisak ta in!
Kote tungah hong heh paisuak ding na hi hiam? Khang tawntungin heh paisuak ding na hi hiam?
Nangmah kong phat theih nadingun ko na mite hong nungtasak kik lo ding na hi hiam?
Topa aw, kote tungah na itna kip hong lak in la, na hotkhiatna kote hong pia in.
Topa Pasian’ thu gen ding hong zasak dih un, bang hang hiam cih leh amah in ama lamah a lungsim uh tawh a kiheite, ama mi siangthote, a mite tungah kilemna thu gen ding hi.
I gam sungah minthan’na a om theih nadingin amah a zahtakte’ adingin ama hotkhiatna hong om takpi hi.
Itna kip leh thutakna kigawm ding a, thumanna leh kilemna kihual ding uh hi.
Leilak panin thutakna hong po khiato ding a, thumanna in vantung panin ensuk ding hi.
Hi hi, Topa in a hoih nate hong pia ding a, i leitang in hauhna piangsak ding hi.
Thumanna in Topa ’ mai-ah mapai ding a, ama lampi bawlkhol ding hi.
